summary: MARA is a next-generation Android malware detection framework that transforms fragmented static and behavioral signals into coherent, human-understandable malicious behavior chains using a unified perception–reasoning–action pipeline. It introduces Behavior-Centric Evidence Structuring (BCES) to reorganize heterogeneous Android artifacts into a structured, behavior-oriented evidence space and Multi-Stage Behavior Reasoning (BCMR) to perform progressive reasoning using a Large Language Model (LLM). MARA delivers high detection accuracy and strong interpretability, outperforming traditional static detectors and recent LLM-based malware analysis frameworks.
